opening: I'm excited to apply for this role focused on retrieval and recommendation systems. My graduate work in AI, combined with hands-on experience building retrieval-augmented and recommendation pipelines, has sharpened my focus on hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation for production-grade systems.

experience_paragraphs.experience_1: As a Machine Learning Research Intern at Example Research Lab, I built a data-cleaning pipeline that merged 5 heterogeneous lab datasets, trained a baseline classifier that improved validation F1 from 0.71 to 0.84, and wrote automated tests that eliminated a recurring weekly pipeline regression.
experience_paragraphs.experience_2: As an AI Engineer Intern at Example Data Systems, I automated a manual data-labeling step that cut turnaround time from 2 days to 4 hours, and integrated a vector database into an internal search prototype with evaluation scripts the team still relies on.

project_paragraph: In Project Atlas and Project Beacon, I designed a document-classification pipeline with a 91% held-out accuracy and a collaborative-filtering recommendation prototype that improved offline NDCG@10 from 0.41 to 0.53, each backed by a reproducible evaluation harness.
closing: I'd welcome the chance to bring this combination of retrieval, evaluation, and production-engineering experience to your team. Thank you for your consideration — I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.
